权限也看你属于哪个组。groups 列出当前用户的主组和附加组，组名之间用空格分: Group membership helps decide access. groups lists your primary and supplementary groups, separated by spaces.

这个终端也对应一个文件路径。tty 显示当前终端设备；pts 通常表示伪终端。: Your terminal has a device path too. tty shows it; pts usually identifies a pseudoterminal.

只想知道服务在不在运行？is-active 给出简短状态，active 表示正在: Just need to know if a service is running? is-active gives a short status. active means running, not necessarily enabled at boot.
先准备一张空白交接单。touch 遇到不存在的文件会创建它，遇到已有文件则不会清: Start with a blank handoff note. touch creates a missing file and leaves an existing file's contents intact.
路径里绕了几个弯？realpath 把 .、.. 等部分解析成完整绝对路径，方便: A path taking a few detours? realpath resolves parts such as . and .. into a full absolute path.
有些命令就住在 Shell 里面。type 能区分内建命令和外部程序，cd 属于: Some commands live inside the shell. type distinguishes builtins from external programs; cd is a builtin.
临时工作也要有独立空间。mktemp -d 创建一个名称不冲突的目录，模板末尾的: Temporary work needs its own space. mktemp -d creates a uniquely named directory by replacing the template's trailing X characters.
清空内容，文件还要留着。truncate 调整文件长度；长度设为 0，就会丢弃原: Empty the contents, keep the file. truncate changes a file's length; setting it to 0 discards its contents.
副本里也不能漏掉子目录。cp 的递归选项会沿着目录往下复制，嵌套配置也一起带走。: Don't leave subdirectories out of a backup. Recursive cp follows the directory hierarchy and copies nested configuration too.
空行也算一行！nl 默认跳过空行编号；想连续编号，要明确让所有行都参与。: Blank lines count too! nl normally leaves them unnumbered; choose the mode that numbers every line.

看起来一样，还得逐字节核对。cmp 用退出码告诉你是否相同；相同的时候，终端通常: Looking identical isn't enough. cmp checks byte by byte and reports the result through its exit status; equal files normally produce no output.

把长长的缩进收紧一点。unexpand 可以把行首空格换成 Tab，换算时要用同: Tidy up that long indentation. unexpand can replace leading spaces with tabs; use the same tab-stop width when converting.
一行太长，就分几行读。fold 按指定宽度折行；这里按字符计数，不会替你改写文字: A line too long to read? fold wraps it at a chosen width. This sandbox counts characters and preserves the text.

磁盘、分区、文件系统，先分清这几层。lsblk 用层级展示块设备，-f 会补上文: Disk, partition, filesystem—separate those layers first. lsblk shows block devices in a hierarchy; -f adds filesystem and mount-point details.

> 把标准输出（命令的正常结果）写入文件；不存在则创建，已存在则先清空。: > writes standard output (the normal command result) to a file, creating it if absent or clearing it first if it exists.
>> 把标准输出接在文件末尾，保留原内容；符号本身不会补换行。: >> appends standard output to a file, keeping its contents. The operator itself does not add a newline.
< 把文件内容交给命令的标准输入，也就是命令读取数据的入口。: < supplies a file's contents to standard input, the channel through which a command reads data.
| 把前一条命令的标准输出交给后一条的标准输入；不会自动保存成文件。: | passes one command's standard output to the next command's standard input. It does not automatically save a file.
&& 只在前一条命令成功时执行后一条；Shell 用退出码 0 表示成功。: && runs the next command only if the preceding command succeeds. The shell uses exit status 0 for success.
|| 只在前一条命令失败时执行后一条；非零退出码通常表示失败或特殊状态。: || runs the next command only if the preceding command fails. A nonzero exit status usually indicates failure or a special result.
; 分隔多条命令，依次执行，不根据前一条的成功与否决定是否继续。: ; separates commands and runs them in order, regardless of whether the preceding command succeeds.
- 开头的选项调整命令行为；文件名、路径、数量等参数告诉命令处理什么。负数不一定: Options starting with - change command behavior. Arguments such as paths, filenames or counts specify what to process. Negative numbers are not necessarily options.
引号可把带空格的文本或路径作为一个参数；单引号保留字面内容，双引号中仍可展开变量: Quotes keep text or paths containing spaces in one argument. Single quotes preserve literal text; double quotes still allow variable expansion.
* 匹配任意长度的名称片段，? 匹配一个字符；Shell 通常先展开未加引号的文: * matches any length of a name; ? matches one character. The shell normally expands unquoted filename patterns before running the command.
$NAME 或 ${NAME} 会替换为变量的值；单引号中的 $ 保持原样。: $NAME or ${NAME} is replaced by the variable's value. Inside single quotes, $ stays literal.
Shell 是解释命令的程序；内建命令由 Shell 自己执行，外部命令则由独立: A shell interprets commands. Builtins run within the shell itself; external commands run as separate programs.
终端此刻所在的目录，是相对路径的起点；浏览文件面板不会改变终端的工作目录。: The terminal's current directory is the starting point for relative paths. Browsing the file pane does not change it.
Absolute paths start at the root directory /. Relative paths start at the working directory. . means the current directory; .. means its parent.
主目录是当前用户存放个人文件的目录；~ 是它的简写，当前用户的主目录是 /hom: Your home directory holds personal files. ~ is its shorthand; the current user's home is /home/learner.
名称以 . 开头的文件或目录默认不在普通目录列表中显示；隐藏不等于加密或禁止访问: Files and directories whose names start with . are omitted from ordinary listings. Hidden does not mean encrypted or inaccessible.
PATH 是查找外部命令时依次搜索的目录列表；可执行文件是能作为程序运行的文件。: PATH lists directories searched in order for external commands. An executable is a file that can run as a program.
递归处理会沿目录层级进入子目录，把里面的文件与更深层目录也纳入处理。: Recursive processing descends into subdirectories, including their files and any deeper directories.
标准输入接收数据，标准输出返回正常结果，标准错误输出报告错误；普通管道默认只连接: Standard input receives data, standard output carries normal results, and standard error reports errors. Ordinary pipes connect only standard output by default.
换行符标记一行的结束；最后一行没有换行符时，wc -l 不会计入它。字节是数据大: A newline ends a line. wc -l does not count a final line without a newline. A byte measures data size, not character count.
正则表达式描述文本匹配规则；^ 表示行首，$ 表示行尾。它与文件名通配符的规则不: Regular expressions describe text patterns. ^ marks the start of a line and $ its end. These rules differ from filename wildcards.
一行数据中的各列叫字段；逗号、冒号、Tab 等分隔符决定各字段的边界。: Each column in a data row is a field. Delimiters such as commas, colons or tabs mark field boundaries.
数值排序比较数字大小；字典排序比较字符顺序，所以 10 可能排在 2 前。: Numeric sorting compares values; lexical sorting compares character sequences, so 10 may come before 2.
相邻去重只合并连续出现的重复行；分散的重复项通常需要先排序再处理。: Adjacent deduplication merges only consecutive repeated lines. Repeats scattered through a file usually need sorting first.
Tab 是制表符，会移动到下一个制表位；它占用的显示宽度取决于当前位置，不是固定: A tab moves to the next tab stop. Its displayed width depends on its position, rather than always equalling a fixed number of spaces.
退出码是命令返回给 Shell 的状态：0 通常表示成功，非零可能表示失败或特殊: An exit status reports a command's result to the shell. 0 usually means success; nonzero can mean failure or a special result, such as differences found.
r、w、x 分别表示读、写、执行；三位权限数字依次对应所有者、所属组、其他用户，: r, w and x mean read, write and execute. Three digits specify owner, group and others; each digit adds the corresponding values 4, 2 and 1.
目录的读权限允许列出名称，执行权限允许进入目录或通过它访问文件；增删条目通常需要: Read permission lists names; execute permission allows entering or traversing a directory. Adding or removing entries normally requires both write and execute permission.
所有者是文件归属的用户；用户组把多个用户归为一组，权限可分别授予所有者、组成员和: The owner is the user a file belongs to. Groups collect users together; permissions can apply separately to the owner, group members and everyone else.
umask 从新建文件或目录的默认权限中去掉指定权限位，不会修改已有文件，也不是: umask removes selected permission bits when creating files or directories. It does not change existing files and is not ordinary decimal subtraction.
sudo 按系统授权以其他用户身份执行命令，通常是管理员 root；它不是命令本: sudo runs a command as another user when authorized, usually the administrator root. It is separate from the command being run.
硬链接为同一份文件数据增加名称；符号链接保存目标路径，原目标被移动或删除后可能失: A hard link adds a name for the same file data. A symbolic link stores a target path and may break if the target is moved or deleted.
归档把多个文件及目录结构装进一个包；解包把它们恢复到目录。归档不一定压缩，也不自: An archive bundles files and their directory structure. Extraction restores them to a directory. Archiving need not compress data or delete originals.
压缩把数据编码为通常更小的形式，解压恢复原内容；压缩与把多个文件打成一个归档是两: Compression encodes data in a usually smaller form; decompression restores it. This differs from bundling multiple files into an archive.
进程是正在运行的程序实例；PID 是进程编号，同一个程序可以有多个进程。: A process is a running instance of a program. Its PID is its process ID; one program may have multiple processes.
信号用于通知进程采取动作；TERM 请求正常退出，KILL 强制终止，可能来不及: Signals ask processes to act. TERM requests an orderly exit; KILL forces termination, potentially before data can be saved.
文件系统组织设备上的文件与目录；df 查看文件系统空间，du 汇总文件或目录的占: A filesystem organizes files and directories on storage. df reports filesystem space; du totals usage by files or directories. Their scopes differ.
块设备按数据块读写，硬盘属于块设备；分区把磁盘划分成多个区域，文件系统通常建立在: Block devices read and write data in blocks; disks are block devices. Partitions divide a disk into regions, often used to hold filesystems.
挂载把文件系统连接到目录树；作为访问入口的目录叫挂载点。根目录 / 是整棵目录树: Mounting attaches a filesystem to the directory tree. Its entry directory is the mount point. The root directory / starts the entire tree.
内存供运行中的程序使用；Swap 是可用于换出内存页的交换空间，不等于额外的物理: Running programs use memory. Swap is storage that can hold evicted memory pages; it is not extra physical RAM.
内核是管理硬件、内存、进程等资源的系统核心；Linux 发行版还包含 Shell: The kernel manages hardware, memory, processes and other resources. A Linux distribution also includes a shell, tools and packages.
CPU 执行程序指令；系统负载描述运行或等待运行的任务压力，不等同于 CPU 使: The CPU executes instructions. System load describes pressure from running or waiting tasks, rather than a percentage of CPU usage.
会话记录一次登录及其活动；终端是输入命令和查看结果的界面，伪终端常用于图形终端窗: A session tracks a login and its activity. A terminal is the command input/output interface; graphical terminals and remote connections often use pseudo-terminals.
环境变量保存 Shell 及其子进程使用的配置；export 把变量放入后续子进: Environment variables hold settings used by the shell and its child processes. export includes a variable in future child processes' environments; unset removes it.
IP 地址标识网络接口在网络中的地址；网卡接口负责收发数据，一台主机可以有多个接: An IP address identifies a network interface's address on a network. Interfaces send and receive data; a host can have several interfaces and addresses.
路由决定数据包从哪里发出；没有更具体路由时，通常经默认网关转发到其他网络。: Routes determine where packets go. If no more specific route exists, packets usually go through the default gateway to other networks.
端口区分同一主机上的网络服务；监听表示程序正在等待接收发往该端口的连接或数据。: Ports distinguish network services on a host. Listening means a program is waiting for connections or data addressed to a port.
域名是便于记忆的网络名称；DNS 把域名解析成 IP 等记录，A 记录对应 IP: Domain names are memorable network names. DNS resolves them into IP addresses and other records; an A record holds an IPv4 address.
客户端发送 HTTP 请求，服务器返回状态码、响应头和正文；200 通常表示请求: A client sends an HTTP request; the server returns a status code, headers and a body. 200 usually means success.
响应头描述响应状态、内容类型等元信息；正文才是传回的数据。只看响应头不会下载完整: Headers carry metadata such as the content type; the body holds the returned data. Requesting headers only does not download the full body.
服务通常在后台提供功能；现在运行与开机自动启动是两个独立状态，需要分别设置和检查: Services usually provide functions in the background. Running now and starting automatically at boot are separate states to configure and check.
软件包包含程序及相关文件；软件源提供可安装的软件包和索引，包管理器负责安装、卸载: A package contains software and related files. Repositories supply packages and indexes; a package manager handles installation, removal and dependencies.
元数据描述文件的路径、大小、权限、所有者等属性，与文件正文内容不同。: Metadata describes attributes such as a file's path, size, permissions and owner, rather than its text contents.
扩展名是文件名末尾的约定；真实文件类型还要检查文件内容，不能只看 .txt、.s: An extension is a naming convention. To identify the actual file type, inspect its contents rather than relying only on suffixes such as .txt or .sh.
主机名是机器在系统中的名称，不一定是完整域名，也不保证能通过 DNS 解析。: A hostname is a machine's name within the system. It need not be a full domain name or resolvable through DNS.
ISO 日期用 YYYY-MM-DD 表示年、月、日；date 的 %F 表示这: ISO dates use YYYY-MM-DD for year, month and day. In date, %F represents this format.
CSV 用逗号分隔字段；简单表格可按逗号切列，字段自身含逗号或引号时需要专门的: CSV separates fields with commas. Simple tables can be split on commas; fields containing commas or quotes require a dedicated CSV parser.
临时文件用于短期工作；唯一名称避免覆盖已有文件，模板中的 X 会由创建工具替换。: Temporary files serve short-term work. Unique names avoid overwriting files; the creation tool replaces X characters in the template.
命令历史记录执行过的命令文本；清屏不会清除历史，也不会撤销已经完成的操作。: Command history records executed command text. Clearing the screen neither erases history nor undoes completed operations.
格式占位符描述输出数据的形式：%s 表示字符串，%d 表示整数，\\n 表示换行: Format placeholders specify how data is printed: %s for a string, %d for an integer, and \n for a newline.
查找深度从起点算起，起点深度为 0；文件类型用于区分普通文件、目录和符号链接，后: Depth starts at 0 for the search root. File types distinguish regular files, directories and symbolic links; a name's suffix does not determine its type.
